title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 2 at 3:19PM EDT until September 2 at 4:30PM EDT by NWS Detroit/Pontiac MI
description: At 318 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Unionville, or near Akron, moving east at 50 mph. HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees. This severe storm will be near... Sebewaing, Unionville, and Gagetown around 325 PM EDT. Cass City and Owendale around 330 PM EDT. Ubly and Argyle around 350 PM EDT. Deckerville around 400 PM EDT. Forestville around 410 PM EDT. Other locations impacted by this severe thunderstorm include Parisville, Colling, White Rock, Ivanhoe, Rapson, Wisner, Ellington, Elmer, Gilford, and New Greenleaf.
text:
At 3:18 PM Eastern Daylight Time, a severe thunderstorm was located near Unionville, or near Akron, moving east at 50 miles per hour. Hazard, hailstones the size of ping pong balls and 60 miles per hour wind gusts. Source: Radar indicated.

Impact: People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Impact: People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.
